candidate_status: unique research artifact; local format checks pass; portal acceptance and hidden-fault skill are untested
reasons_closed: No compatible, independently reproducible current-best spatial holdout checkpoint is available for GEMSDOE38.
The user-reported H33-2-B2 0.2778 mapping is not tied to an organizer-exposed file hash; GEMSDOE32's own holdout evidence has missing tracked inputs and conflicting logged/code fold settings.
GEMSDOE32's live-mirror receipt reproduced only 2 of 6 logged historical orderings (3 of 6 after its own prevalence calibration), so its proxy is not a promotion-grade benchmark.

The D raster's historical 19+D feature comparison used the incomplete public catalogue as a proxy and did not test the final 0.7%/3.0px/tip-protected emission and catalogue exclusion as an artifact-level model-vs-current-best comparison.

The preregistered J feature did not show a reliable incremental gain over the frozen D model: +0.000712 DTI, 2/4 folds positive, paired 20 km block bootstrap 95% interval [-0.004698, +0.006037] on the public catalogue proxy.
Final review found that the as-coded L variant differs from its registered signed side-contrast formula; its MINE values are exploratory only and no solo L spatial comparison was run.
Neither zero-outside nor NaN-outside encoding has been accepted by the competition portal; local disk-reread validation is not portal certification.

evidence.h33_public_evidence_review: GEMSDOE32 commit b63ebab7dbcf9238422ebbc2dbc4addf84bed11b; findings summarized in knowledge/research-review.md

requirements_to_reopen: Restore or regenerate exact versioned holdout data and confirm its hashes and split parameters against the current checked-in code.
Reproduce the prior H33/current-best raster and baseline on the same frozen spatial test cells, with all features, model fitting, emission policy, exclusion policy and paired uncertainty reported.
Use a genuinely held-out fault truth set or a clearly qualified independent analogue whose source data and provenance are available; do not treat unlabelled zero cells as verified negatives.
Pass the preregistered incremental candidate-vs-current-best gate without changing budget, spacing, collar or thresholds after seeing the result.
Keep submission encoding and organizer portal acceptance distinct from local TIFF validation; obtain an actual portal acceptance result before claiming certification.
decision: Retain the unique TIFF as a clearly marked research/download artifact. Do not recommend or perform a weekly submission or final-round selection from the present evidence.
